label: V6.4.139 - DESKTOP FORM UI
notes: Desktop UI correction: My Flight is explicitly positioned beside the persistent sidebar; operational command controls return to the balanced two-row geometry used in V6.4.88 while retaining the new navy UI styling; operational paper fields, text inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios are forced back to readable light form styling so the dark glass shell cannot black them out. Mobile interaction behavior is unchanged.
message: V6.4.139: sửa layout PC, cân lại hàng nút theo bố cục V6.4.88 nhưng giữ UI mới, khôi phục field biểu mẫu nền sáng.
